data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for the Interactive Media Ads SDKs on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Integrates Google's Interactive Media Ads (IMA) SDK into Flutter apps to request VAST-compliant multimedia ads and manage their playback. It renders ads in a separate container layered over content video players like the video_player plugin.
use_when: You need to display VAST-compliant video ads in your mobile application.
You are using a video player package and want to monetize content via pre-roll, mid-roll, or post-roll ads.
avoid_when: You require background audio ads or Google Dynamic Ad Insertion methods, which are currently unsupported.
You only need standard mobile banner or interstitial display ads instead of video IMA ads.
strengths: Direct integration with official Google IMA SDKs for Android and iOS.
Provides granular controls for ad events, requests, and playback managers.
weaknesses: Requires manual platform-specific configuration such as Android Manifest permissions and Java library desugaring.
Background audio ads and Google Dynamic Ad Insertion are not supported.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permissions and enabling coreLibraryDesugaring in Android's build.gradle.kts.

alternatives.name: google_mobile_ads
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want standard banner, interstitial, or rewarded ads rather than VAST-compliant IMA video stream ads.
